annotations.title: Flood insurance cost by ZIP (FEMA NFIP)

description: Flood insurance cost by ZIP (FEMA NFIP) — What NFIP flood insurance actually costs in a US ZIP code: policies in force, median/average annual cost (premium plus fees), cost in high-risk vs moderate/low zones, single-family median, cost per $1,000 of coverage, coverage amounts, flood-zone mix, mandatory-purchase share, and the community's NFIP status and CRS discount class. Param: zip= (5-digit ZIP). Source: FEMA OpenFEMA policies (latest 12 months of data). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: realestate_flood_insurance
